006e1c0c3d7e2ed0.name: fade_out_breath_sprites
006e1c0c3d7e2ed0.doc: Slows the fade of all breath sprites and waits 90 frames so they disappear gradually.

00a3833e44d41ff2.name: spawn_shell_casings_at_owner
00a3833e44d41ff2.doc: Every 15 frames moves one of two model copies, alternating, to 30 units above the owner's dcol00 frame and prints the frame position and rotation. Loops until the effect is stopped.

01074d1f7976549a.name: play_tornado_attack_effect
01074d1f7976549a.doc: Places the tornado model at the work position and creates a small spherical attack that deals the effect value as damage. The attack ends on the first hit or after 18 frames, and the effect lasts 40 frames in all.

01b2ef228864162d.name: lob_sticky_glob
01b2ef228864162d.doc: Throws a sticky glob dealing effect value 0 damage along a falling arc for up to 90 frames. It stops on hitting the player or a wall; when a guard knocks it back it spawns a guard effect and flies back along the knockback direction for up to 60 frames, again stopping on a hit or a wall. Only after a wall hit does it stay at the wall and fade out over 30 frames.

01e609826a7c5fd1.name: fire_demon_beam_from_owner
01e609826a7c5fd1.doc: Charges, then holds, then retracts the demon beam on the owner's dcol2 bone, aimed at the target. The phase is driven by effect value 1 (1 starts the beam, 2 ends it, 3 finishes the return) and a child hit effect follows the target point.

04ba8c3c942f5b1c.name: explode_treasure_chest
04ba8c3c942f5b1c.doc: Plays the explosion animation and a 120 unit damage area at the work position, removing the attack when the animation ends.

0925380a530d2046.name: fly_thunder_bolt_at_target
0925380a530d2046.doc: Monica's thunder magic projectile. Spawns a lightning sprite trail that curves toward the target (or 400 units ahead if there is none), and spawns the thunder hit effect when it touches something. Effect value 0 scales the size.

0996a90bf57d90b8.name: throw_item_projectile
0996a90bf57d90b8.doc: Finish program of the thrown item: flies it from the owner's item bone toward work vector 1 in an arc, bouncing off walls and floor and spawning grass, dust or splash effects where it lands, with an attack matching the item id (gift, fruits or pebble; a test attack otherwise). When the attack hits something or after 60 frames it spawns the item's burst effect (explosion, magic stone, final bomb or lightning flash).

0ed5e44fbb32e9bb.name: play_barrel_smoke
0ed5e44fbb32e9bb.doc: Allocates one smoke sprite, launches it at the work position and for 150 frames turns it into a fading puff once it is bright. Hides the sprite at the end.

0f54d7402baceaa4.name: fly_griffon_feather
0f54d7402baceaa4.doc: Shoots a Griffon feather forward in a random-speed line for up to 90 frames with a damage attack, spawning the feather hit effect on contact with a target or wall. Afterwards it fades out and hides the model.

0f7ddf0688338d45.name: fly_venom_glob
0f7ddf0688338d45.doc: Lobs a venom glob forward in an arc, with a damaging attack active after frame 5. When it hits a wall or a target it spawns the venom hit effect there, and the attack is removed at the end.

123043fc9876df3a.name: play_big_explosion_effect
123043fc9876df3a.doc: Plays the explosion model with a radius 50 attack dealing the damage in effect value 0, removed after 30 frames, and plays sound effect 7 from the sound bank of the scene character whose slot is effect value 1. Waits 40 frames and then for the motion to end.

12fa5fb66e3a2983.name: fly_homing_wind_blast
12fa5fb66e3a2983.doc: Monica's wind magic. It spawns a spiralling sprite blast that flies out near the owner, then curves toward the target (or 400 units ahead if there is none), accelerating up to 16 units per frame for up to 90 frames. On an attack hit it spawns the Monica wind hit effect and passes the power on to it; a wall hit ends it.

1309659b4c6e305c.name: launch_smoke_puff
1309659b4c6e305c.doc: Puts one sprite at a random point within spread of x, z, gives it a random upward velocity, spin and scale, and fades its alpha in.

1477019043c8df89.name: play_wind_shot_launch_effect
1477019043c8df89.doc: Plays the wind shot firing motion at the work position, fades it in and holds for 25 frames.

15310a30ca8c5eaa.name: lob_fire_ball_then_drop_pillar
15310a30ca8c5eaa.doc: Flies a spark-trailing ball in a straight line up at 60 degrees toward the player for 15 frames plus the count in work vector 2, then moves it 200 units above a point offset from the player (angle and distance also from work vector 2) and drops it at 20 units per frame for up to 60 frames, spawning a fire pillar where it hits the ground. The fire attack is first created for the drop, and its shape is placed at the velocity vector rather than at the ball.

1661c796e9399446.name: play_dragon_fire_pillar
1661c796e9399446.doc: Plays a fire pillar at the work position with a damaging hitbox that disappears on the first hit or after 13 frames, then waits for the motion to end.

180042808184f853.name: play_beam_attack_from_muzzle
180042808184f853.doc: Boss beam: follows the owner's tama bone while it charges, then spawns the beam child effect and a damaging attack and keeps aiming at the target. The monster script advances effect value 1 (1 fires, 2 ends the beam, 3 ends the return motion).

192d5f43ae473ef5.name: fly_cross_slash_projectile
192d5f43ae473ef5.doc: Flies a cross slash projectile forward, starting at 10 units per frame and accelerating by 1.2 each frame, with a knockback attack. At frame 115, or at once when it hits a target or a wall, the attack is removed and the projectile keeps flying while it fades out over its last 15 frames (130 in all).

1a283ba7952ed346.name: emit_ember_sprites
1a283ba7952ed346.doc: Allocates 210 additive ember sprites and, every frame unless effect value 2 is 1, starts two rising, fading embers at random spots within 20 units of the first work vector. Visible sprites below height 2 lose their sideways drift and are pushed back up from below 0, and fully faded ones are hidden. Runs until the effect is stopped; returns 0 at once if the sprites cannot be allocated.

1a986c18d0fa4650.name: on_play
1a986c18d0fa4650.doc: Throws a spinning knife forward from the owner's dcol01 frame with a normal attack. It slows and drops as it flies, bounces a few times when it hits level geometry, and disappears on hitting a character or after 60 frames.

1c02509c2d9b8834.name: play_thrown_arrow_attack
1c02509c2d9b8834.doc: The arrow flies from the owner's dcol0 bone along the owner's facing for up to 60 frames, slowing and dropping after 30 frames, with a normal attack that deals effect value 0. When it hits a wall it bounces off without damaging for up to 20 frames, unless the bounce would go upward or the arrow has already dropped more than 10 units below its start height. On hitting a character it vanishes; otherwise it fades out over 30 frames.

1eda9a46739ef6d4.name: play_hit_spark_effect
1eda9a46739ef6d4.doc: Plays the hit motion at the effect's work position and waits for it to end.

20c5d90660d90dae.name: fly_homing_griffon_feather
20c5d90660d90dae.doc: Flies a Griffon feather in a curved path that bends toward the player (live tracking if the second effect value is 1) for up to 90 frames. It bursts into a feather hit effect on striking a wall or the player, otherwise fades out.

20e866a6aae87c24.name: fly_fire_shot
20e866a6aae87c24.doc: Reads damage and speed from effect values 0 and 1 and the direction from the second work vector, then moves the fire shot for up to 90 frames with a hit shape of radius 10. On a hit or wall collision it spawns the fire pillar effect with the damage value and ends.

214acbb1c79a927f.name: play_warship_damage_explosion
214acbb1c79a927f.doc: Places the model at the first work vector, turned to the rotation in the second, plays its explosion motion once (the model's motion is named after the buggy explosion) and ends after 47 frames.

215229502dc1f014.name: play_fire_pillar
215229502dc1f014.doc: Plays the fire pillar motion with a radius 20 damaging attack that ends on the first hit or at frame 13. Effect value 0 is the damage.

21b555ec6535e9cf.name: follow_owner_with_activate_model
21b555ec6535e9cf.doc: Effect script that plays the model's activate motion and snaps the model to its owner's position and rotation at the start and again after 24 frames, then runs until frame 68.

22966d265598fba1.name: on_play
22966d265598fba1.doc: Shock wave that travels straight along the work rotation for up to 115 frames, damaging with the amount in effect value 0. It stops on a hit or wall, then fades out while drifting 15 more frames.

239b5bbb3c7c943d.name: lob_cannonball_and_explode
239b5bbb3c7c943d.doc: Throws a half-size cannonball on a ballistic arc from the first work vector toward the second for up to 120 frames, using a hit-test attack to detect the player. It always ends by spawning the large explosion, where it hits a wall or the player or at its last position when time runs out, passing on the damage (effect value 0) and effect value 1.

23fadbd6d31fc95c.name: fly_dragon_fire_shot
23fadbd6d31fc95c.doc: Flies a dragon fire shot at the speed given by effect value 1 for up to 90 frames. The attack starts at frame 4, and a hit on a target or wall spawns the dragon fire hit effect and passes on the damage.

24a9246c723496a2.name: play_fire_muzzle_flash
24a9246c723496a2.doc: Places the model at the work vector pos and rotation, plays the fire motion, fades the model in, and hides it when the motion ends.

24dbf779036c01e7.name: fly_machine_gun_bullet
24dbf779036c01e7.doc: Moves a machine gun bullet from the first work vector by the second each frame for up to 60 frames, with a 1-unit line attack dealing effect value 0. When it hits a wall it plays sound 5 from the sound bank of the character whose slot is in effect value 1 (the firing gun) and then ricochets along the reflection at half speed for 6 frames without an attack. Returns 0 at once when it hits a target.

252757432c4abb94.name: emit_smoke_trail_sprites
252757432c4abb94.doc: Allocates 16 smoke sprites (returns 0 if that fails) and follows the owner forever, launching a rising sprite from sprites 0 to 14 every 4 frames and a puff every 16 frames. Only the first puff uses the larger sprite 15; the puff index is then reset to 0, so later puffs reuse sprite 0. Sprites fade out once they reach their peak brightness.

26b5fafa336fbbc5.name: play_thunder_shot_hit
26b5fafa336fbbc5.doc: Plays hit sound 72 and the thunder shot hit motion at 1.5 scale at the work position.

27606a140ebd0143.name: play_green_expanding_ring_effect
27606a140ebd0143.doc: Effect script: a green additive glow that grows and fades at the effect position. The variant is forced to 0, so the spinning shrinking variant 1 never runs.

27872ee96d5614f9.name: play_smoke_puff
27872ee96d5614f9.doc: Plays the smoke motion at the work position, scaled by effect value 0 (1.0 if unset), and waits until the motion finishes.

28e925ae6ef9abf6.name: play_flash_burst_effect
28e925ae6ef9abf6.doc: Additive flash. Effect value 0 selects the mode: 0 is a white core that grows and fades with a gold glow, 1 is only a glow using the color given in effect values 1 to 4. Over 5 frames the glow fades out, flaring back briefly on the third frame.

294aa7daf94a7774.name: on_play
294aa7daf94a7774.doc: Shows the spin attack loop model following the owner's position for the number of frames in effect value 1, scaled by effect value 2, then fades it out over 15 frames.

2c35d69126adab6d.name: play_shockwave_attack
2c35d69126adab6d.doc: Shockwave with a strong knockback attack whose radius grows from 15 to 40, 70 and then shrinks to 50, ending at frame 26. The damage comes from effect value 0.

2d716e572705bc7e.name: play_self_destruct_blast
2d716e572705bc7e.doc: Plays the self-destruct motion with a large knockback attack of radius 35 that lasts until the first hit or frame 34.

2f511aba7901e87c.name: play_hit_model_effect
2f511aba7901e87c.doc: Places a hit effect model at the work position, plays its hit motion once and waits until the motion ends.

3045190f77d2d577.name: fire_delayed_wind_ball_arc
3045190f77d2d577.doc: Wind ball that fades in and waits delay frames, then flies for up to 60 frames. Each frame it moves by the arc offset for that frame (forward speed times frame, down gravity times frame squared over 2, from the effect values) instead of to it, so it speeds up and drops ever faster. Spawns the wind shot hit effect on hitting a target or a wall.

30ae9a842591619e.name: play_flame_puff_burst
30ae9a842591619e.doc: Effect script: spawns three fire puffs with ten sparks each around the effect position for 60 frames, silent. Same as the version with a battle sound.

318d7decacb0d60e.name: draw_sparkle_beam
318d7decacb0d60e.doc: Sets up 600 sparkle sprites and every frame spreads them evenly along the line from the start point to the end point, which the starter can change while it runs.

323bba621825ca5f.name: on_play
323bba621825ca5f.doc: Fire shot projectile that flies up to 90 frames with a fire attack, bursting on a hit or wall. If a guard knocks it back it turns around along the reflected direction for up to 60 frames and can hurt the original caster.

327e0c631c64a89c.name: play_pirate_bomb_explosion
327e0c631c64a89c.doc: Effect script: plays the explosion model at work vector 1 and runs a 20 unit damaging attack (damage from effect value 0) for 30 frames.

335cf3befe97028b.name: on_play
335cf3befe97028b.doc: Keeps a glow sprite on the owner and, on every frame that effect value 7 is set, launches one coloured orb from the owner toward the target character (effect value 1), cycling through a pool of 15 orb sprites. Orbs vanish when they reach the target or fade out; the colour comes from effect value 0. Runs until the finish program takes over, and returns 0 at once if the sprites cannot be allocated.

344ef9d263e7897e.name: play_petrify_ball_shot
344ef9d263e7897e.doc: Fires a petrifying ball in an arc for up to 60 frames with a petrify attack dealing the damage in effect value 0, spawning the sticky hit effect on a hit or a wall. If another attack knocks it back (with a nonzero direction), it flies back along that direction for up to 60 more frames as a petrify attack owned by slot 0 and spawns the water shot hit effect where that flight ends.

355525a0d1b52e90.name: raise_ice_pillar
355525a0d1b52e90.doc: Raises a monster ice pillar with a 25 radius knockback attack that ends on the first hit, at frame 48 or when the motion is nearly done.

35f9b01bb0cc3b28.name: play_shockwave_burst
35f9b01bb0cc3b28.doc: Plays the activation motion at the work position with a radius 30 attack that lasts 16 frames. Effect value 1 selects the attack: 0 is a weak knockback and 1 is a normal hit. Effect value 0 is the damage.

36b5c4d0bfda5e8a.name: fly_homing_scale_powder
36b5c4d0bfda5e8a.doc: Flies a cloud of butterfly scale powder at 12.5 units per frame for up to 300 frames: along its starting rotation for the first 7 frames, then straight at the player until frame 30, then on in the last direction. Turning toward the target only rotates the model. It re-creates its radius 20 attack at its current position every 6 frames and stops on a hit or a guard, then fades out.

378232c04e45e402.name: emit_slow_smoke_sprite
378232c04e45e402.doc: Same as the smoke sprite emitter but slower and with a gentler fade, used for the larger puffs.

38c46f5663edcde9.name: drift_spore_cloud
38c46f5663edcde9.doc: Moves the main spore sprite upward 3.4 units per frame while it wobbles on a small circle, and every second frame starts a free puff at its position. Puffs fade by 6 alpha per frame and switch to a thinner frame below alpha 48. After frame 90 the main sprite fades out, and the effect ends at frame 120.

38dfbbd55f8d4335.name: follow_owner_with_activation_model
38dfbbd55f8d4335.doc: Plays the activate motion of the effect model and keeps it on the owner character for 48 frames.

3964d70f57138a35.name: emit_train_smoke
3964d70f57138a35.doc: Runs forever emitting smoke from the chimney of the train event object (effect value 0), fading out each sprite as it ages. Effect value 1 switches emission on or off. Returns 0 if the sprites cannot be allocated.

3b44dd22a09fe8f9.name: play_fireball_launch_effect
3b44dd22a09fe8f9.doc: Places the fireball launch model at the work position and rotation, plays the fire motion at 1.5x scale for 24 frames, then hides it.

3e64f6fac7dfa77d.name: play_rising_sprite_burst_effect
3e64f6fac7dfa77d.doc: Effect script that scatters four sprites around the work vector, each rising and spinning with random speed, while all four grow and fade out from alpha 92 over 30 frames.

3eb4924c067bbe9d.name: launch_homing_fire_bolt
3eb4924c067bbe9d.doc: Fires a fire bolt from the work position toward the target, or 300 units ahead of the owner with no target, steering gradually toward the target for up to 120 frames while leaving a sprite trail. It spawns the Monica fire hit effect when it touches a wall or an enemy.

4021c7feae2b7833.name: fly_sticky_spit
4021c7feae2b7833.doc: Launches the sticky liquid model forward in an arc for up to 100 frames. From frame 5 it has an attack, and it stops with the sticky hit effect when it hits something, a wall, or is guarded (which also spawns a guard effect).

42e21d852ed293a4.name: play_fire_pillar
42e21d852ed293a4.doc: Fire pillar at 3x scale with a radius 25 attack, weakened to a radius 30 weak attack at frame 10 and removed on the first hit or at frame 20. Waits for the motion to end.

43816f36bea5de8e.name: play_warp_effect_following_owner
43816f36bea5de8e.doc: Plays the warp motion and keeps the model 8 units above the owner for 36 frames, then deletes the attack.

45ad9e1bb752f12d.name: follow_owner_with_electric_aura
45ad9e1bb752f12d.doc: Fades in a looping electric model at double scale and keeps it 15 units under the owner's marioa_null bone for 30 frames, then hides it at once. The fade-out it starts never shows, because the second follow loop also stops at frame 30 and cannot run.

494c6824c0cf7eb4.name: throw_poison_arc_projectile
494c6824c0cf7eb4.doc: Lobs a poison blob in an arc along the target's facing for up to 60 frames. It bursts into a poison hit effect when it touches a wall or hits something.

495d8a1631f4a7f9.name: lob_pump_bomb
495d8a1631f4a7f9.doc: Lobs a knockback bomb in a ballistic arc from the work position in the target's facing direction for up to 60 frames. When the path hits something it deletes the attack and spawns a small explosion there.

4b88038d833d82ee.name: emit_smoke_sprite
4b88038d833d82ee.doc: Places a smoke sprite at a random spot around the point, moving it upward and along the heading with a fade-in.

4bd6bfca47b61153.name: on_play
4bd6bfca47b61153.doc: Loops a malfunction model on the player and keeps emitting grey smoke puffs that rise and grow at a random point near the player. Never ends by itself.

4d68e78e69b0c10a.name: on_play
4d68e78e69b0c10a.doc: Plays the water shot hit model at the work position with its sound at scale 1.5 and waits for the motion to end.

4ead05defc3cb109.name: on_play
4ead05defc3cb109.doc: Places the paralysis activation model at the work position and rotation, fades it in, and keeps the effect alive for 20 frames.

4f3bcc12f46f17ca.name: play_poison_mist_hit
4f3bcc12f46f17ca.doc: Places the model at the work position, plays the hit motion scaled 1.5x and waits 20 frames.

4fdb76011df0f0ee.name: play_curse_shot_effect
4fdb76011df0f0ee.doc: Places the curse projectile model at the work position and rotation, scaled to 1.5, and plays its fire motion until it ends.

503f902fdd91cd4b.name: play_bullet_hit_effect
503f902fdd91cd4b.doc: Shows the hit motion at the work position and waits until the motion ends.

52fc28c3d4c500a7.name: fire_water_shot_projectile
52fc28c3d4c500a7.doc: Water ball that flies forward for 60 frames, dropping slowly, and bursts on hit or wall. A guarded or knocked back shot flies off in the knockback direction and can still hit.

536ac8dcc81b0ec9.name: play_lightning_hit_sparks
536ac8dcc81b0ec9.doc: Builds a flash sprite, a burst of radiating sparks and four jagged lightning bolts at the work position, sized by effect value 0 (0 to 1). It runs 32 frames flickering the bolt sprites.

5612c53b230399ec.name: play_spin_attack_effect
5612c53b230399ec.doc: Shows a looping spin model over the owner, following the owner's position. On frame 9 a 15 unit knockback attack is created in front of the owner and it is removed after 20 frames, then the model fades over 25 frames.

5868148363879cc3.name: fly_robot_missile
5868148363879cc3.doc: Flies a robot missile at 16 units per frame, turning slowly toward the target. It leaves smoke every third frame and explodes on a wall, within 24 units of the target or after 150 frames.

593cd29a941cacb0.name: scatter_sparkle_sprites
593cd29a941cacb0.doc: Shows three sparkle sprites scattered randomly around the work position that rise, spin, grow and fade in then out over 30 frames.

596ab2cbd5190ed5.name: spawn_breath_sprite
596ab2cbd5190ed5.doc: Spawns one breath puff sprite near the given point at a random angle and radius, drifting along the normalized direction with falling acceleration and fading in.

598e2afd0b538362.name: play_cold_mist_effect
598e2afd0b538362.doc: Hit effect of Monica's ice bolt (c02cold_h): over 10 frames the model rises from 30 units below the work position to just above it while a ring of fading, growing mist sprites spawns around it; it then holds 10 frames and fades out. Effect value 0 (0.0 to 1.0) scales the size and picks the sound.

5d37a569612628aa.name: wait_motion_end
5d37a569612628aa.doc: Waits until the current effect model motion ends, one frame at a time.

5dd7529be0a10cbc.name: drift_magic_toward_target
5dd7529be0a10cbc.doc: Fades the magic model in, moves it slowly toward the second work vector for 15 frames, then fades it out while it keeps drifting for 15 more.

610f415accf24409.name: play_rising_embers
610f415accf24409.doc: Spawns 8 ember sprites at random positions around the midpoint between the two work points, then raises them for 20 frames while they fade out. Returns 0 early if sprites cannot be allocated.

62d427a1ee6070ea.name: fire_thunder_ball
62d427a1ee6070ea.doc: Fades in a thunder ball, waits 10 frames, then flies it forward on a slight arc for up to 60 frames. It bursts into a hit effect on a hit or a wall, shows a guard effect if knocked back, and a guarded ball flies back along the knockback direction.

64c49df69b40c298.name: play_fireball_hit_explosion
64c49df69b40c298.doc: Plays the fireball hit motion at the work position with a small knockback attack that lasts until its first hit or frame 16. Damage comes from effect value 0.

64c88f75adbce4ef.name: play_sticky_hit
64c88f75adbce4ef.doc: Places the sticky hit model at the work position and plays its hit motion for 20 frames.

6558733880353ed8.name: fire_feather_shot
6558733880353ed8.doc: Tigrif feather projectile. It flies straight and slightly downward for up to 90 frames with a medium attack of the given damage, and on hitting a wall spawns the feather hit effect and fades the model out.

656bed3a7f02b017.name: on_play
656bed3a7f02b017.doc: Plays a beam model that follows the work vector, scaled by effect value 1, with a strong knockback attack of 45 radius until effect value 2 is set. It then plays the return motion and ends when it finishes.

657b36d8636d5f1c.name: on_play
657b36d8636d5f1c.doc: Flies a curse ball forward for up to 60 frames with a curse attack, spawning the curse hit effect on hitting a character or wall. If the ball was blocked it is sent back in the knockback direction as a Mintz sword attack for another 60 frames.

66291109f99a7fd9.name: fly_paralysis_shot
66291109f99a7fd9.doc: Flies a paralysis shot from the work position along the work direction for up to 90 frames, with a paralysis attack sphere. On an attack hit or wall hit it spawns the paralysis hit effect there.

676c24562bc1befc.name: spawn_fire_trail_sprites
676c24562bc1befc.doc: Turns on 8 ember sprites scattered around the midpoint of the two positions. Returns the next first-sprite index, wrapping at 160.

68e860bbccdf1018.name: fade_out_union_effect
68e860bbccdf1018.doc: Fades the model out and waits 25 frames.

69ce5c91f935a30f.name: shoot_ice_ball
69ce5c91f935a30f.doc: Fades the ice ball in, waits 10 frames, then flies it along its facing for up to 60 frames with an ice attack. A parried hit spawns the guard effect and sends the ball back along the knockback direction for another 60 frames; hits on enemies or walls spawn the ice shot hit effect.

69d9e9be427e26be.name: play_fireball_launch
69d9e9be427e26be.doc: Plays the fireball launch motion at the work position and waits for it to end.

6d97558eea98232d.name: play_shockwave_activation_effect
6d97558eea98232d.doc: Places the model at the work position and rotation, plays the activate motion and waits 20 frames.

6f7e56988a7dad83.name: fly_memeater_bullet
6f7e56988a7dad83.doc: Flies a Memeater nose machine gun bullet at five times the work velocity for up to 150 frames. It spawns the Memeater shot hit effect on hitting a target or a wall. Damage comes from effect value 0.

6f9350f926cb1504.name: fire_flame_shot_projectile
6f9350f926cb1504.doc: Fire ball that flies forward for 60 frames, dropping slowly, and bursts on hit or wall. If the player knocks it back with an attack it flies off in that direction and can still hit.

6fa7776e2b17d746.name: on_play
6fa7776e2b17d746.doc: Plays the fireball hit model at the work position with its sound at scale 1.5 and waits for the motion to end.

6ff7045cf82e351b.name: launch_orb_toward_target
6ff7045cf82e351b.doc: Shows a sprite at the point and sends it flying toward the chest of the given scene character at speed 3.8, fading in and growing as it goes.

709cec6ef08aeac5.name: play_shield_effect
709cec6ef08aeac5.doc: Places the shield model, plays its activation motion, then the loop motion for 30 frames, and fades it out over 25 frames.

72c4c2b683cb3ce7.name: play_heal_sparkle_effect
72c4c2b683cb3ce7.doc: Effect script: three glowing orbs spiral up around the target character leaving sparkle and tail sprites. Effect value 0 picks the colour, 0 for blue and 1 for yellow.

734072fb439171cb.name: play_lightning_hit_effect
734072fb439171cb.doc: Lightning impact effect at the work position: a flash sprite, a burst of sparks flying outward and four randomly rotated bolt sprites. The effect value (0 or 1) selects a small or large version and the sound.

7357198af71cb5a9.name: play_cold_shot_hit
7357198af71cb5a9.doc: Plays the cold shot hit sound and model at 1.5x scale, then waits for the motion to end.

741632f75062eee8.name: sparkle_around_owner
741632f75062eee8.doc: Every frame spawns four blinking star sprites at random spots within a box around the owner, using a random quarter of the sprite sheet, for 90 frames, then waits 30 more.

76f34cdc9b924850.name: follow_chara_while_rapid_firing
76f34cdc9b924850.doc: Plays the rapid fire model and keeps it on the scene character given by effect value 1 for up to 300 frames. It stops when effect value 0 becomes non-zero.

76f5e82d0dc86f84.name: flash_spark_sprite
76f5e82d0dc86f84.doc: Shows one additive spark sprite at the work position, ramps its alpha up in five frames, then fades it out.

792df24c37cbb8a9.name: play_smoke_puffs_effect
792df24c37cbb8a9.doc: Spawns 8 spinning smoke sprites at random offsets around the first work vector that rise and fade out; the second work vector gives the horizontal and vertical scale. Lasts 60 frames.

7ac9a19a92b6938b.name: play_fireball_drop_attack
7ac9a19a92b6938b.doc: The double-size fireball rises at 60 degrees toward the player at 16 units a frame for 15 frames plus the first component of the second work vector, then falls straight down at 20 units a frame from 200 units above the player, offset by the angle (degrees) and distance in the other two components, for up to 60 frames. It spawns the fireball hit effect where it hits the ground or a wall. Its 6-damage knockback attack is made with create_damage and the other damage natives, which are disabled in this build, so it deals no damage.

7d495c8167e3f099.name: throw_lobbed_bomb
7d495c8167e3f099.doc: Lobs a bomb along an arc for up to 90 frames and spawns a small explosion on hitting the player or a wall. If the player's guard knocks it back, it spawns a guard effect and flies back along the knockback direction, exploding on the first thing it hits.

7e44ba612ad62a38.name: play_flame_puff_burst_with_sound
7e44ba612ad62a38.doc: Effect script: spawns three fire puffs (smoke and glow sprites) with ten sparks each at random moments around the effect position over 60 frames, with a battle sound. Effect value 0 to 1 scales size; below 1 it plays battle sound 70, at 1 or more sound 76.

7ee658319062aaa1.name: play_explosion_effect
7ee658319062aaa1.doc: Explosion effect. Effect value 0 selects the size and damage (1 normal 100, 2 larger 400, 3 largest 800, 4 small 40, 5 treasure chest explosion with no damage set); the attack is removed on the first hit or at frame 30, and the effect lasts 114 frames.

7f463bd54f92302d.doc: Places the flash model at the owner's work position and rotation, plays its fire motion and fades it in, then lasts 25 frames. The direction and velocity it works out are not used.

7f9ad5f3fff94058.name: shrink_rose_and_remove_attack
7f9ad5f3fff94058.doc: Removes the attack and shrinks the rose model to nothing over 9 frames.

823cbb66f2b9a822.name: fly_arrow_at_player
823cbb66f2b9a822.doc: Holds the arrow model on the owner's arrow bone until effect value 1 is set, then flies it straight for 9 frames and homes it toward the player for up to 60 frames. Effect values 2 to 6 set speed, acceleration, whether it keeps tracking the player, homing strength and a sideways turn. It deals normal-attack damage and fades out on a hit or when its time runs out.

8278f0d0d79584ae.name: play_rising_smoke_puffs
8278f0d0d79584ae.doc: Spawns eight smoke sprites at random spots around the work position that drift upward, spin and grow while fading, and runs for 150 frames.

83627cabb48846f5.name: play_shockwave
83627cabb48846f5.doc: Shows a shockwave model at the given scale and keeps a 30 radius knockback attack alive for 16 frames.

838a1e48d81e5996.name: play_wind_shot_hit_effect
838a1e48d81e5996.doc: Plays the wind shot hit sound and motion at the work position, then waits for the motion to end.

8537e71ae4ceb3dd.name: play_hit_spark_for_fixed_time
8537e71ae4ceb3dd.doc: Plays the hit motion at the work position and holds the effect for 22 frames.

862b08d88e656bfb.name: play_rose_vine_shot
862b08d88e656bfb.doc: Flies the rose from the first work point to the second over effect value 2 frames and holds there until effect value 7 is set to 1. It then circles 30 units around the first work point, read again, until value 7 is set to 1 again, and finally flies toward the second work point, read again, at speed value 1 for value 2 frames as a rose attack dealing value 0 damage. At the end it always spawns the rose hit effect, at the hit position, at its last position before a wall, or where the flight ran out, passing the damage and owner id.

8631326384f946b5.name: launch_rising_sprite
8631326384f946b5.doc: Shows a sprite at a random point within a radius around the given position, then sets it moving up and sideways along the given direction, fading in, spinning and growing slowly.

87467b9a55d69804.name: fade_out_glowing_orb
87467b9a55d69804.doc: Ends the glowing orb effect: hides the glow and trail sprites, shows the two spinning sprites at the work position with new textures and expands them while fading their alpha to zero, then waits 30 frames.

87b14b60c94d66a1.name: launch_smoke_puff
87b14b60c94d66a1.doc: Shows one smoke sprite at a random spot within a radius of the given point, rising with a random speed and spin, and fading in.

88204b7c4ba94bca.name: fly_final_bomb_arc
88204b7c4ba94bca.doc: Lobs a bomb forward for up to 90 frames with a damaging attack, exploding into the final bomb hit effect on contact with a target or wall. If a guard knocks it back it is sent back along the reflected direction for up to 60 frames and explodes on hitting something.

8954705ee311e76d.name: play_rainbow_fire_pillar
8954705ee311e76d.doc: Reads the damage from the effect value, plays the rainbow butterfly fire pillar motion at double scale, and creates a radius 20 attack with that damage. The attack is removed on first hit or at frame 20.

89c8bb92926a4649.name: charge_demon_beam_flash
89c8bb92926a4649.doc: Scales the model, plays its attack 2 start motion and keeps it glued to the owner's dcol2 frame for 73 frames. The frame counter is never initialised.

89f1b2eb2d67f472.name: play_rose_hit_effect
89f1b2eb2d67f472.doc: Places the rose hit model at the first work vector, plays its hit motion once, plays sound 8 from the sound bank of the character whose slot is in effect value 1 (the rose's owner), and waits for the motion to end.

8b6078bc23ad5d1d.name: play_beam_trail
8b6078bc23ad5d1d.doc: Plays the trajectory motion and lays a fading glowing sprite trail along the moving tama frame, four sprites per frame, until the motion ends, then waits 30 frames.

8bf54097fedb0d2b.name: play_fire_pillar_blast
8bf54097fedb0d2b.doc: Spawns a fire pillar at the owner's eff1 point, scaled to 0.65, with a knockback attack of radius 25 that ends on first hit or frame 48.

8cddb9c61a0e2817.name: fade_out_sparkle_beam
8cddb9c61a0e2817.doc: Keeps the sprites spread along the beam while lowering their alpha by 4 per frame, and ends when they are invisible.

8e842a5c8930e4f1.name: shoot_thunder_ball
8e842a5c8930e4f1.doc: Thunder ball moving at speed from effect value 1 for up to 90 frames. It bursts on a hit or wall, and if guarded it bounces back for 60 frames as a second attack.

8e8b3dc5f1ade30c.name: set_orb_color_by_type
8e8b3dc5f1ade30c.doc: Colours a sprite red, blue or yellow depending on effect value 0 (0, 1 or 2) with the given alpha.

8f69fb99c19843f9.name: drift_pollen_cloud
8f69fb99c19843f9.doc: Builds 50 pollen sprites in a ring around a fixed point in the Rafflesia room and for 160 frames spins sprites 0 to 24 and 25 to 49 in place in opposite directions. Their alpha rises by 1 per frame to just over 80 and then falls back for the rest of the run, and a pollen sub effect is spawned every 12 frames.

8f9df77934ccb040.name: on_play
8f9df77934ccb040.doc: Places the warp model at the work position and plays its warp motion for 36 frames.

903472175e0df030.name: burst_flame_stone
903472175e0df030.doc: Plays the flame animation with sound effect 11 and a 15 unit damage area for up to 30 frames. The attack is removed on the first hit or at frame 30, then it waits for the animation to end.

90bf436966c8c76e.name: fly_straight_bullet
90bf436966c8c76e.doc: Fires a bullet in a straight line at the speed given by effect value 1, with a damaging hitbox, until it hits something or 90 frames pass.

932191736c397f0e.name: play_holy_burst
932191736c397f0e.doc: Plays the holy burst with sound effect 11 at the work position and a radius 15 attack. Effect value 0 picks the attack: 1 the holy magic stone, 2 holy water. The attack ends on the first hit or at frame 30; the effect then runs to frame 40 and waits for the motion to end.

9420b65330998139.name: fire_homing_gil_magic
9420b65330998139.doc: Waits 10 frames, shows the magic loop model at the owner's magic point for 24 frames, then hides it and sends an invisible weak knockback attack dealing effect value 0 forward in 16-unit steps along the second work vector's rotation. It steers slowly toward the target while the target lies within 1.2 radians of its heading, spawns the Gil magic sub effect every other frame at a fixed height of 2.5, and runs until it hits a wall.

94dd029b916b2a71.name: start_dust_puff_sprite
94dd029b916b2a71.doc: Starts one rising, fading sprite at a random spot within a radius of the given position, with random size and upward speed.

9544364b90ce2ad5.name: play_magma_splash
9544364b90ce2ad5.doc: Plays a slowed, enlarged magma splash model at the work position and waits for it to finish.

95f79ad51b5a40fa.name: play_combo_attack_motion
95f79ad51b5a40fa.doc: Places the model at the work position and rotation and plays the attack 4 motion to its end.

982d6d060e37ff2e.name: play_tinted_hit_model
982d6d060e37ff2e.doc: Effect script that places a hit model at work vector 1, colours it with work vector 2 at alpha 128 with scene lighting off, scales it by effect value 0 (1 when that is 0) and fades it in, then waits until its hit motion ends.

990309dc3d010229.name: play_homing_arrow_attack
990309dc3d010229.doc: Holds the arrow on the owner's arrow bone until effect value 1 is set, then gives it one of six attacks at random (normal, curse, sticky, petrify, venom, DE arrow) dealing effect value 0 damage and flies it for up to 150 frames, starting at speed value 2 and accelerating by value 3. It flies straight for value 5 frames, homes toward the player with strength value 4 until frame value 6, then keeps its heading. A hit spawns the DE arrow hit effect; after a wall hit the arrow stays at the wall and fades out over 60 frames, otherwise it vanishes at once.

99fb058ef37fecd0.name: on_play
99fb058ef37fecd0.doc: Monica's thunder magic: a jagged lightning bolt drawn from sprites that starts beside the caster and homes in on the target (or 400 units ahead if none), spawning the thunder hit effect when it touches something. Returns 0 early if no sprites can be allocated.

9a9fc0f7ac970424.name: on_play
9a9fc0f7ac970424.doc: Shows an MP jet model attached to the owner's jet_r or jet_l bone (chosen by effect value 1) until effect value 0 becomes nonzero, then fades it out over 30 frames while still following the bone.

9db8d5804931b99b.name: play_fish_breath_effect
9db8d5804931b99b.doc: Emits breath sprites from the owner's sakana frame toward its ef_null frame, two per frame from a pool of 600, bouncing them off the water level and fading them. Runs until effect value 3 becomes 1, then fades the remaining sprites.

9f73d4c2bcd016cf.name: lob_holy_ball
9f73d4c2bcd016cf.doc: Fades in a holy ball, then lobs it along an arc with a damaging hitbox until it hits the player or a wall and bursts. If the player knocks it back it is sent flying back as a fire shot along the knockback direction.

a0479408d3499532.name: remove_attack_and_wait
a0479408d3499532.doc: Removes the attack and waits 30 frames so the dust can fade.

a064bd654114fadc.name: play_heal_on_target
a064bd654114fadc.doc: Plays the recover motion for 90 frames, keeping the model on entry point 0 of the scene character whose slot is given by the first effect value.

a0c4b11b6897393a.name: wait_effect_frames
a0c4b11b6897393a.doc: Waits the given number of frames inside an effect script.

a19dd62656507663.name: play_final_bomb_blast
a19dd62656507663.doc: Effect script for the final bomb: plays battle sound 56, creates an 80 radius attack at work vector 1, plays the hit model's motion there and fades it in at the scale given by effect value 1 (default 1.0), then waits for the motion to end.

a40cfa7e36c377c5.name: play_growing_model_effect
a40cfa7e36c377c5.doc: Shows a model at the work position with a random yaw, grows it with decaying speed for 55 frames and fades it out from frame 30.

a5893099e19d6bdd.name: fire_homing_magic_bolt
a5893099e19d6bdd.doc: Giltoni magic, cast by Gaspard (b03a): waits 10 frames, shows the magic loop model at the owner's magic bone for 24 frames, then hides it and sends an invisible knockback attack dealing effect value 0 from there, heading along the second work vector's rotation at 16 units a frame. It turns slowly toward the target while the target lies within 1.2 radians of its heading, spawns the Giltoni magic sub effect every other frame at a fixed height of 489.5, and runs until it hits a wall.

a5993b7bed290787.name: play_chest_explosion
a5993b7bed290787.doc: Plays the explosion motion at the work position and waits 70 frames.

a67e6d58eadbb4ca.name: play_beam_charge_at_muzzle
a67e6d58eadbb4ca.doc: Scales the model by effect value 0, plays the attack 2 start motion and keeps it on the owner's tama bone for 73 frames.

a7521a98f5fea7c9.name: on_play
a7521a98f5fea7c9.doc: Plays the wind shot hit model at the work position with its sound at scale 1.5 and waits for the motion to end.

a7cf70e749496005.name: drift_snow_sprites
a7cf70e749496005.doc: Endlessly spawns four snowflake sprites every other frame at random places over the area given by the work vectors, recycling a pool of sprites whose size is effect value 0.

a8fd4b1f74d39b22.name: do_nothing
a8fd4b1f74d39b22.doc: Empty placeholder used where a script needs a call that does nothing.

a91dc05dee190000.name: on_play
a91dc05dee190000.doc: Drips spark sprites from three bones on the owner (eff0_01 to eff0_03), bouncing them on the ground unless effect value 1 is set and hiding them once faded. Effect value 2 equal to 1 stops new sprites. Returns 0 if sprites cannot be allocated.

a9b773a09bf67263.name: spawn_trailing_dust_attack
a9b773a09bf67263.doc: Every 4 frames puts a line of 10 expanding dust sprites along the segment from start to end, while a linear attack covers that segment. The attack is removed after its first hit, and the effect keeps running until it is finished.

aab448f7dfa4426d.name: show_union_effect_until_finished
aab448f7dfa4426d.doc: Fades in a large model at the work position and then waits forever until the effect is finished.

ac5c215f200f79fa.name: play_curse_hit_effect
ac5c215f200f79fa.doc: Plays the hit motion at 1.5x scale at the work vector and waits for it to finish.

ae8f7805caace771.name: release_homing_scale_powder
ae8f7805caace771.doc: Moves a scale powder cloud for 300 frames, steering it slowly toward the target, and sheds glittering sprites around it. Every 6 frames it renews a 20-unit attack. Damage comes from effect value 0.

af2e14b39b3ea800.name: play_event_homing_flame_shot
af2e14b39b3ea800.doc: Cutscene version of Monica's homing flame shot. It steers toward the target while drawing a flame sprite trail, and spawns the event fire hit effect on a wall hit or when within 20 units of the target. Returns 0 if no sprites could be allocated.

afa5529f16df1295.name: fire_curving_fire_ball
afa5529f16df1295.doc: Fire ball that starts off to the side (work vector 2 gives speed, homing weight and side angle) and curves toward the player, trailing ember sprites; it re-reads the player's position each frame only when its target is 1, otherwise it aims at where the player stood at launch. A wall hit between frames 11 and 82 removes its attack and spawns a fire pillar there; otherwise it fades out at frame 77 and ends 16 frames after frame 90. Its attack shape is placed at the step vector rather than at the ball. Returns 0 if its sprites cannot be allocated.

b055237c74082097.name: get_angle_from_model_to_point
b055237c74082097.doc: Writes the horizontal angle from the model's position toward the given point into out_angle[0].

b45c9218c8c0c872.name: emit_smoke_from_owner
b45c9218c8c0c872.doc: Allocates 540 smoke sprites (returns 0 if that fails), then every frame fades the existing ones and, while effect value 2 is 0, emits two small sprites per frame and a larger puff every fourth frame from each of the owner's eff0_03, eff0_01 and eff0_02 frames. The per-emitter radius and angle are passed in swapped order, so the sprites start within about 1.6 units of each frame and drift along a heading of 200 or 100 radians.

b5255e266a0543d0.name: follow_owner_bone_with_fade
b5255e266a0543d0.doc: Effect script that loops forever: keeps the model on the owner's 'tama' frame at the scale in effect value 1, shows it when effect value 0 is nonzero and hides it when it is 0, and while effect value 2 is 1 or 2 starts a fade-out each frame, clearing value 2 once that has run for more than 15 frames.

b54f65d35235e16d.name: play_wind_puff_effect
b54f65d35235e16d.doc: Spawns 20 rising wind-textured sprites around the effect position with a wind sound. Effect value 0 (0 to 1) scales size, speed and picks the louder sound at 1.0. Returns 0 if no sprites could be allocated.

b5d2a14d79676f10.name: play_nose_bomb_explosion
b5d2a14d79676f10.doc: Plays the explosion motion at the work position with a 20-unit attack that is removed after 30 frames. Damage comes from effect value 0.

b7e2b294f93aacb5.name: stop_gun_sound
b7e2b294f93aacb5.doc: Stops the owner's sound effect slot 4, the gun fire loop.

b885581c3910c007.name: fly_fox_bullet
b885581c3910c007.doc: Fires a sprite bullet from the work vector along the owner's facing at 20 units per frame, with a damage hit sphere and sparkle trail. It stops on an attack hit, a wall hit or after 300 frames.

b99592594f804256.name: on_play
b99592594f804256.doc: Fires Gil 2's homing fireball. It starts with a random aim offset around the owner's heading, steers toward the target over 45 frames with a sprite trail, and spawns the hit effect on hitting a wall or a character. Effect value 0 scales its power and speed, value 1 is the damage.

bb072b1761d0a10f.name: fly_sticky_shot
bb072b1761d0a10f.doc: Shoots a sticky projectile forward for up to 60 frames with a damage attack, spawning the sticky hit effect when it touches a target or wall.

bb1395a6f0ee2bb0.name: shoot_sticky_ball
bb1395a6f0ee2bb0.doc: Projectile aimed at 15 units above the player, moving 12 per frame for up to 60 frames. Effect value 1 selects a sticky attack and 0 a normal one; a hit or wall spawns the sticky splash effect.

bd0a2b590d4d99ec.name: fly_homing_ice_bolt
bd0a2b590d4d99ec.doc: Flies Monica's ice bolt forward for up to 120 frames, bending toward the target and leaving a trail of ice sprites. It spawns the Monica ice hit effect on a wall or an attack hit.

bd2511fa55f5ac9e.name: play_holy_stone_burst
bd2511fa55f5ac9e.doc: Plays the holy motion at the work position with a radius 15 attack that is removed on the first hit or at frame 30. Effect value 1 uses the holy stone attack and 2 uses holy water.

bef80a89f58caf61.name: show_rising_sparkles
bef80a89f58caf61.doc: Effect: three small sprites float up from the effect position, growing and fading in then out over 30 frames.

befb0aa9c471d075.name: fly_homing_missile
befb0aa9c471d075.doc: Robot missile that flies forward 48 units a frame and turns toward the target by a small limit, trailing smoke sprites. It explodes on a wall or hit and self-destructs after 90 frames; it does nothing if sprites cannot be allocated.

bf559f0086460eb4.name: spawn_handfire_sprite
bf559f0086460eb4.doc: Turns one sprite on near a hand position with a random offset, an upward velocity, and a fade-in plus shrink, to make a rising ember.

c1f9d0b47b889c9b.name: play_cold_shot_fire
c1f9d0b47b889c9b.doc: Plays the cold shot launch motion at the work position, fading the model in at scale 1.5, and holds for 25 frames.

c2543954e7d43388.name: fire_homing_flame_shot
c2543954e7d43388.doc: Monica's fire magic projectile. It launches at a random spread around the caster's facing, then for up to 60 frames turns a sixth of the way toward the target (or a point 300 ahead) whenever it is within 1.6 radians of it, draws a flame sprite trail and checks for wall or attack hits. On a hit it spawns the Monica fire hit effect and passes the power along; it then removes the attack and waits 20 frames. Returns 0 at once when its sprites cannot be allocated.

c282bb3dcfc16282.name: launch_wind_projectile
c282bb3dcfc16282.doc: Effect script for Monica's wind magic: a spinning wind sprite trail curves out from the caster and homes in on the target (or flies forward with no target) at growing speed. It spawns the wind hit child effect when it touches an enemy or a wall.

c2a548fa60653366.name: play_explosion_blast
c2a548fa60653366.doc: Plays the explosion motion and sound with a radius 12 knockback attack that ends on first hit or frame 15. The first effect value is the damage.

c2d9081b0abdfd67.name: fire_wind_ball_with_rebound
c2d9081b0abdfd67.doc: Wind ball flying on an arc after a 10 frame fade-in. If the attack is knocked back (guard or reflect) it spawns a guard effect and sends the ball back along the knockback vector with a second attack; otherwise it bursts on contact.

c3a730b4a344df0a.name: play_smoke_puffs_ahead_of_owner
c3a730b4a344df0a.doc: Spawns 10 smoke puff sprites over 90 frames at random spots 25 units in front of the owner, each fading in and then out.

c675e8cb528f6851.name: play_paralysis_hit_effect
c675e8cb528f6851.doc: Places the paralysis hit model at the work position, scaled to 1.5, plays its hit motion and waits for it to end.

c6f37f44428c3812.name: fly_fireball
c6f37f44428c3812.doc: Flies a fireball forward for up to 60 frames with a slight drop, creating a fire shot attack after 10 frames. It spawns a fireball hit effect on an attack hit or on a wall.

c82dc1349eaddacc.name: fire_homing_ice_bolt
c82dc1349eaddacc.doc: Effect script for Monica's ice magic: an ice bolt flies from the caster, steers toward the target with a smoky sprite trail and spawns the ice hit effect when it touches something or hits an enemy, then fades its model out and waits 20 frames. Effect value 0 is the charge level that sets speed and size. Returns 0 at once when its sprites cannot be allocated.

c97941511dfafc16.name: wait_scaled_frames
c97941511dfafc16.doc: Waits for the given number of 30 fps frames, converted to 25 fps (frames / 30 * 25).

cfea39c00f418b32.name: fly_homing_missile
cfea39c00f418b32.doc: Flies a robot missile forward at 48 units per frame, trailing smoke sprites, and steers it toward the target (1/12 of the way each frame) while the target lies within about 44 degrees of its heading. It spawns an explosion when it hits a wall or its attack hits, and after 90 frames it simply ends without exploding. Returns 0 at once if the sprites cannot be allocated.

d06b11c3de1b6f53.name: on_play
d06b11c3de1b6f53.doc: Spawns 24 rising wind sprites around the work position for 20 frames, scaled by effect value 0, then waits 10 more frames.

d220e7649f412179.name: fire_arcing_flame_shot
d220e7649f412179.doc: Flame shot that curves along a rotated arc for up to 60 frames. On a wall or target hit it removes the attack and spawns a fire pillar child effect with the damage value.

d2450f6793f6b9e6.name: play_chill_stone_blast
d2450f6793f6b9e6.doc: Plays the cold air motion and sound at the work position and creates the chill stone attack with radius 15. The attack is deleted when it hits or at frame 30, and the effect lasts 114 frames.

d2fa53e3480d2412.name: play_spinning_model_pop_effect
d2fa53e3480d2412.doc: A model at work vector 1 fades in and spins, grows from scale 0.4 to 2.2 over the first 3 frames, then shrinks at a slowing rate while it fades out from frame 9. The effect lasts 35 frames; the shrink turns back into growth after about 12 frames, by which time the model has faded.

d32060bfd9bafe2f.name: shoot_petrify_bolt
d32060bfd9bafe2f.doc: Petrifying projectile that flies in an arc for up to 90 frames and stops on hit or wall. If a guard knocks it back, it flies back along the knockback direction for up to 60 frames as a second attack.

d4f33e0a736caa99.name: on_play
d4f33e0a736caa99.doc: Homing arrow: the model stays on the owner's arrow bone until effect value 1 is set, then flies for up to 150 frames, curving toward the player with a random attack type (normal, curse, sticky, petrify, venom or DE arrow). Spawns a hit effect on contact or wall impact and fades the model out after a wall hit.

d5073b9d3d82208c.name: play_holy_shot_hit
d5073b9d3d82208c.doc: Plays the holy shot hit animation at the work position with sound effect 74, then waits for it to end.

d5a05b280bbf78cf.name: fire_curving_fireball
d5a05b280bbf78cf.doc: Launches a fire shot dealing effect value 0 from the first work vector. Its first heading is turned 90 degrees sideways from the aim line (toward the target character when effect value 4 is set, else toward the second work vector) and rolled around that line by value 3. For the first value 7 frames it homes with strength value 2 toward the target character, aiming 10 units above where it stood at launch unless value 4 makes it follow the character each frame. It flies at speed value 1, accelerating by value 5, for up to value 6 frames; a hit, or a wall after frame 10, spawns the fire shot hit effect, and if time runs out it fades out over 30 frames.

d690c56bdddc88be.name: play_lightning_flash_effect
d690c56bdddc88be.doc: Effect script: spawns a lightning flash hit model at work vector 1 with a 24 unit attack sphere, scaled by effect value 1, and waits for the hit motion to finish.

d924cffe1101d0ad.name: puff_smoke_sprites
d924cffe1101d0ad.doc: Places eight smoke sprites at random offsets and angles, then grows them and fades them out until fully transparent.

d98870987675e75c.name: fly_cold_shot
d98870987675e75c.doc: Launches a cold shot with a knockback attack of radius 10 (damage and speed from effect values 0 and 1) that flies straight for up to 90 frames. It stops on hitting a target, or spawns an ice pillar where it strikes a wall.

d997b2f1f0e12073.name: fly_sonic_wave
d997b2f1f0e12073.doc: Launches the Griffon sonic wave, a speeding attack that curves toward a point near the player (or tracks the player during frames 7 to 12) for up to 25 frames, then fades out. Effect values are damage, homing strength, tracking flag, fixed-offset flag and bend angle.

d9f78833ef0613d7.name: on_play
d9f78833ef0613d7.doc: Cold shot projectile that flies up to 90 frames with an ice attack, bursting on a hit or wall. If a guard knocks it back it turns around along the reflected direction for up to 60 frames and can hurt the original caster.

db4ed299c609262c.doc: Places the flash model at the owner's work position and rotation, plays its fire motion and fades it in, then lasts 25 frames. The direction and velocity it works out are not used.

db9b995874ad6ae0.name: on_play
db9b995874ad6ae0.doc: Plays the rainbow butterfly fire pillar model at the work position with a 20-radius attack that deals the damage passed in effect value 0. The attack is removed once it hits something or at tick 20 of 24.

dd2e2bb7e7d6ed8c.name: play_chill_stone_burst
dd2e2bb7e7d6ed8c.doc: Cold-air burst of a chill stone: plays the effect and sound at the work position with a radius 15 attack that is removed after a hit or at frame 30, and the effect lasts 114 frames.

df9ea1c0743033f3.name: play_heal_activation
df9ea1c0743033f3.doc: Plays the heal activate motion at the work position and lasts 20 frames.

dfb512f0e3d645aa.name: play_sonic_wave_launch
dfb512f0e3d645aa.doc: Places the model at the first work vector, turned to the rotation in the second, plays its loop motion once from the start, holding the last frame, and ends after 17 frames.

e071b42ab8d637ba.doc: Places the flash model at the owner's work position and rotation, plays its fire motion and fades it in, then lasts 25 frames. The direction and velocity it works out are not used.

e10bdfca952621d5.name: follow_owner_item_bone
e10bdfca952621d5.doc: Effect play program that keeps the model at the owner's item attachment point every frame.

e11369a74cc3e4c1.name: play_hit_flash_model
e11369a74cc3e4c1.doc: Effect: shows a model at the effect position, plays its hit motion and fades it in at the scale given by effect value 0 (default 1.0), then waits for the motion to end.

e1fdfb510ea6fc1f.name: play_bomb_explosion
e1fdfb510ea6fc1f.doc: Plays the explosion motion at double size and keeps a damaging attack sphere alive for up to 15 frames, deleting it earlier after the first hit.

e4a4b5e75eb2e560.name: fire_demon_beam
e4a4b5e75eb2e560.doc: Draws a beam of additive sprites from the owner's dcol2 frame toward the player, with a damaging attack at the beam tip that spawns demon beam hit effects every 6 frames. Effect value 0 set to 2 ends the first sweep and 3 ends the follow-up phase, after which the sprites shrink away.

e5a13469ae78b217.name: shoot_sparkle_bolt
e5a13469ae78b217.doc: Effect script: fires a small sparkle bolt with a fading trail along the work vector direction for up to 60 frames. It stops on hitting a character (returns 0), reflects off a wall and keeps flying for 6 more frames while fading.

e5f552d445074d47.name: get_negated_if_negative
e5f552d445074d47.doc: Returns the negation of a negative argument. For non-negative arguments the result is never assigned, so do not use it for them.

e6417609041583be.name: play_fireball_hit
e6417609041583be.doc: Plays the fireball hit motion at the work position and waits for it to finish.

e7481205c219cca5.name: spawn_exhaust_smoke_puffs
e7481205c219cca5.doc: Every second frame spawns four expanding grey smoke sprites beside the owner, alternating the left and right side. Runs forever until the effect is finished.

e791ee1eef5b9dbd.name: spawn_smoke_puff_sprite
e791ee1eef5b9dbd.doc: Shows one smoke sprite at a random spot within the radius around the centre, rising and fading in with a random spin.

ea397e02046f0b3d.name: play_poison_hit_effect
ea397e02046f0b3d.doc: Plays the poison hit model scaled 1.5 times at the work position for 25 frames.

ea711be56f6f4840.name: fire_curse_shot
ea711be56f6f4840.doc: Launches a curse shot with a knockback attack along the facing direction for up to 60 frames. On hitting a target or a wall it spawns the curse shot hit effect and ends.

eb8553c32778aaa0.name: play_moonflower_beam_burst
eb8553c32778aaa0.doc: Plays the moonflower beam burst motion and leaves a trail of fading sprites along eight grid frames of the model until the motion ends, then waits 30 frames.

ecb48b1dab09f515.name: is_sprite_near_target
ecb48b1dab09f515.doc: Returns 1 when the point is within 7.6 units of the chest height of the scene character given by effect value 1, so the orb can be absorbed.

ecb5f00e9eeba6f5.name: fly_poison_mist
ecb5f00e9eeba6f5.doc: Sends a mummy poison mist forward for up to 60 frames with a damage attack, spawning the poison mist hit effect on contact. Then it fades the model out over 30 frames.

ed56c5142022b58d.name: play_ice_hit_burst
ed56c5142022b58d.doc: Fades in the ice hit model at a scale set by the charge level (effect value 0) and for 10 frames lays icy sprites along the line from 30 units below the hit point up to it. Then waits and fades the model out.

eedf85a77714ef0b.name: play_rising_dust_effect
eedf85a77714ef0b.doc: Four tall streaks rise from around the effect position, and eight puffs drift outward from it and slow down. Runs for 30 frames.

eee8e23df25b2e44.name: fire_shockwave_in_front
eee8e23df25b2e44.doc: Plays the firing motion, then from frame 8 to 18 keeps a damaging hitbox of the given radius 75 units in front of the source.

f13d94a165538e28.name: on_finish
f13d94a165538e28.doc: Fades out the orbs and plays a flash on the target character over 90 frames, with the sprite growing then shrinking at frame 45.

f15220db1b761da6.name: play_gun_impact
f15220db1b761da6.doc: Plays the machine gun impact motion once and ends after 24 frames. It reads the work vectors but never places the model, so the model stays at its starting position.

f160c9664df7261a.name: shoot_nose_machine_gun
f160c9664df7261a.doc: Fast bullet for the nose machine gun attack: moves 5 times its direction each frame for up to 150 frames, damaging from frame 10, and spawns the nose shot hit effect on a character or wall.

f1da562f29bf338b.name: play_rising_puff_effect
f1da562f29bf338b.doc: Spawns 8 spinning smoke sprites at random offsets around the effect position that rise, fade in and fade out, while all 8 grow over 30 frames.

f6de76609ba533c7.name: fly_holy_shot_projectile
f6de76609ba533c7.doc: Flies a holy shot for up to 90 frames with the wind shot 2 damage row. When another attack knocks it back it spawns the guard effect and, unless the knockback direction is zero, flies back along that direction for up to 60 frames as a weak attack owned by slot 0, so it can hit monsters. It spawns the holy shot hit effect on a hit or a wall. Damage comes from effect value 0 and speed from value 1.

f71b96ec7c5bf962.name: float_heal_sparkle
f71b96ec7c5bf962.doc: Shows a single heal sparkle sprite that drifts down while rotating by a random amount and fades out.

fb41cf12da87b808.name: emit_hand_fire_sparks
fb41cf12da87b808.doc: Allocates 160 additive fire sprites and loops forever, spawning four embers per frame alternately at the owner's right (dcol_r) and left (dcol_l) hand points. Used for the burning hands of the b10a monster.

fe855ea337505829.name: play_glowing_orb_loop
fe855ea337505829.doc: Effect script that sets up a growing glow sprite and two spinning sprites at the work position, then follows work vector 1 forever (the frame counter wraps at 100, below its 120 limit), moving the glow every second frame and spawning small shrinking trail sprites. The colours come from the second work vector.
